target.license: User reports owning a Pro key; activation must be verified after clean install
target.hardware: target CPU (verify compatibility); detected RAM capacity usable RAM
target.storage: internal measured system-disk capacity is future Windows/Fedora target only after review; portable measured backup-disk capacity never installer target; separate 16GB USB only after confirmation

modeMeanings.debloat_reviewed: Win11Debloat reviewed candidate switches, still require dry run and user authorization
modeMeanings.privacy_reviewed: Changes have functional/privacy consequences; explicit review
modeMeanings.high_risk_review: Do not auto-enable; review security and recovery
modeMeanings.feature_separate_opt_in: Run alone on installed Pro, admin and reboot expected
modeMeanings.app_removal_separate: Not part of reversible core; app-by-app selection and backup
modeMeanings.custom_review: Some goals cannot be fully guaranteed; manual OS/privacy check
modeMeanings.mixed_manual: Some Windows settings scriptable, browser settings separate
modeMeanings.extra_review: Potentially destructive to current user layout

items.title: Reduce optional telemetry, history, app launch tracking, ad targeting
items.note: Required Windows Pro diagnostics cannot be fully eliminated; activity tracking, advertising ID and consent settings must be verified individually.

items.title: Disable lock-screen and Edge suggestions, tips and advertising
items.note: Edge browser version/policy support varies.

items.title: Disable location services, app access and Find My Device tracking
items.note: Disables location-dependent features and device-finding.

items.title: Hide Microsoft 365 ads in Settings Home (do not remove entire Home default)
items.note: Hide the entire Home page only as a separately selected preference.

items.title: Prevent WSAIFabricSvc automatic start
items.note: Service may be absent; no service deletion.

items.title: Disable Edge, Paint, Notepad AI; Chrome AI requires separately verified Chrome policy
items.note: Chrome browser version-managed settings/manual review; do not write unsupported policies.

items.title: Disable Windows Drag Tray file sharing
Use classic Windows 10 context menu
items.note: Shell update can revert this; avoid patching Explorer binaries.

items.title: Disable Sticky Keys activation shortcut
items.note: Accessibility shortcut changes; Sticky Keys feature remains available manually.

items.title: Disable Storage Sense automatic cleanup
items.note: Keep manual cleanup; verify disk headroom.

items.title: Disable Windows Fast Startup
items.note: Needed to avoid hibernated Windows NTFS when dual booting; separate from turning off full hibernation.

items.title: Disable automatic device encryption of new installation, keep manual BitLocker possible
items.note: Security tradeoff. Does NOT decrypt existing volumes; verify actual encryption and recovery keys before any change.

items.title: Disable Modern Standby network connectivity
items.note: Only on supported S0 Modern Standby hardware, may affect background connectivity.

items.title: Do not receive preview/nonsecurity updates as soon as available
items.note: Keep monthly security patches, Defender updates and servicing enabled.

items.title: Prevent update-triggered restart while a user is signed in
items.note: Not a total restart prevention; still schedule reboots for security patches.

items.title: Disable Delivery Optimization peer-to-peer update distribution
items.note: Keep direct Windows Update downloads working.

items.title: Prevent automatic device companion app download
items.note: Must preserve normal driver installation.

items.title: Enable dark mode for apps and system
Disable transparency, animations and unnecessary effects
items.note: Some visual effects and accessibility/animation controls require manual verification.

items.title: Disable desktop/lock screen Spotlight background
items.note: Desktop and lock screen settings can be independent.

items.title: Clear pinned Start apps, hide recommendations, review All Apps layout
items.note: ClearStart changes custom pins; explicit optional opt-in only; UI may vary by Windows 26H2.

items.title: Disable Start menu Phone Link integration
items.note: Separate uninstall of Phone Link app optional.

items.title: Disable Bing web/Copilot search and Store recommendations
items.note: Avoid filesystem-permission hacks on Store databases.

items.title: Enable End Task on taskbar right-click
items.note: Can force-close unsaved apps.

items.title: Show extensions for known file types
items.note: Security-positive.

items.title: Show hidden files/folders/drives
items.note: Do not disable hiding protected OS files by default.

items.title: Hide Home, Gallery and OneDrive in Explorer pane
items.note: Does not remove personal files.

items.title: Disable window snapping
items.note: May reduce workflow convenience; leave as requested.

items.title: Enable Windows Sandbox
items.note: Windows 11 Pro and AMD virtualization; 8GB class host: avoid concurrent VM use; admin and restart required.

items.title: Enable WSL and Virtual Machine Platform
items.note: Admin, optional reboot, WSL distro installation separate; preserve Docker Desktop.

items.title: Disable Xbox Game Bar recording/integration and uninstall app optionally
items.note: Game DVR and Game Bar disabled by default profile; app removal separate review.

items.title: Disable Brave browser AI/crypto/news bloat
items.note: Apply only if Brave installed; verify Chrome/Brave policies against browser release.

items.title: Remove OneDrive app and hide Explorer integration
items.note: Unlink and verify cloud files are locally backed up before removal; do not delete files; no automatic app uninstall in core.

items.title: Remove optional promotional apps and Widgets
items.note: Core disables Widgets surface; optional Appx removals require explicit per-app selection and separate restore validation.

items.title: Disable Copilot, Recall and Click to Do
items.note: Recall/Click-to-Do disabling is proposed as reviewed core; upstream -DisableCopilot also UNINSTALLS the Copilot app, so Copilot removal is a separate explicit app gate. Hardware may lack Recall/Click-to-Do.

prohibited: execute scripts from winutil ZIP automatically
format any drive or create USB
apply uninstall and encryption edits without separate consent
claim zero telemetry or fully reversible app removal
